metrics.method: Full history 2026-06-08 to 2026-09-10, 888 non-service messages (489 Sarah Lloyd, 399 ours) plus 19 service events. Client side = the 'Sarah Lloyd' alias from config/clients.yaml; our side = everyone else, including the 'Sarah Lloyd chat team' vendor aliases from config/team.yaml. client_questions_total = her messages containing a question mark or an explicit request marker (pls/please/can-could-would we/you/make sure/following up/bumping). unanswered_over_24h = those asks with no message from anyone on our side within 24h (strict-literal measure; the more meaningful figure is unanswered_on_topic_threads, distinct asks that never received a substantive answer from anyone: Meta/FB help 07-11 (18d to first contact), the 20M-to-4M reach explanation, livestream promo MM + Aug 7/15 results, sexting-set consistency (twice, 90d), chargebacks, the Aug 24 screenshot failures, the Aug 25 call write-up, the Chaturbate tracking link, the Phone Farm updates, the trial-reels call, Aug 15-31 payment confirmation). max_team_silence_days counts any outbound from our side; the non-templated figure excludes Michelle's weekly DMCA post, Mica's weekly reel-link drop and Stephski's invoice/reminder cycle. Promises = explicit forward-looking commitments by our side ('I'll get them on it', 'we will make full scripts', 'plenty of updates starting next week'); kept = evidence of delivery or client acknowledgement in-chat; lapsed = no delivery and no retraction; still_open = made within the last ~30 days and not yet due or not yet verifiable.
